description: Get a pre-reasoned market briefing with trends and confidence scores, plus regime classification and a rule based note on what moved with the price in the briefings that carry them, for the requested domain (macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, a listed company, cross-asset or Bitcoin; the same families as the server instructions). Output is written to be read directly by reasoning agents, not parsed for individual values. Find the briefing id with list_briefings first, which also gives each briefing's plan; for one data series rather than a briefing, use get_metric. Needs a PreReason account: a signed in connection or an API key.

block.description: One part of the company briefing, with entity (for example "valuation" or "against_guidance"); today only, except "numbers", which also takes date (its figures as known on that day). Leave out for the whole briefing. A part counts one call; the whole briefing counts one for each part it carries.

date.description: A past date, YYYY-MM-DD: the briefing as of the end of that day (UTC; a company's numbers at the end of the day in its own market), for the periods released by then. Each figure says when it was public, or that it may be a later revision PreReason holds in its place. For a period's latest figures, including later corrections, leave date out. Tier-gated: Free=30d; Basic=3y, Bitcoin briefings from Jan 2025; Pro=all. A company briefing takes one only with block "numbers".

entity.description: The company for a per company briefing: the ticker or CIK of a company filing with the US securities regulator (NVDA), a Japanese securities code (7203), a Korean stock code (005930), an Indian company's ISIN (INE018A01030), the LEI of a company filing in the UK or of a European company (2138002P5RNKC5W2JZ46), a B3 ticker (PETR4) or a Hong Kong stock code written as HK and its five digits (HK00001), with briefing=equities.company

format.description: Response format: markdown (human-readable, default) or json (structured data)

history.description: With block "numbers" alone: the numbers block with its core lines over the last eight quarters, or the half years a company files instead, and five fiscal years, as filed. One call; never part of the whole briefing.

name: get_context
title: Get Market Briefing
